messages:
jamal: hey — quick help please. trying to triage a spike in 5xxs for acme in EU, route `acme-gen-eu`. where's the canonical log query and do we have a saved search I can use?
chris: use the org+route+status filters. quick one: `org:acme AND route:acme-gen-eu AND http.status_code:5* AND region:eu`
maria: +1. if you want only model-specific, add `model:mixtral-8x` (or whatever variant).
jamal: thanks. any example I can paste into the log UI? also would be great to save it for on-call.
chris: paste this into Log Search (top-right query box):
```
org:acme AND route:acme-gen-eu AND region:eu AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599] | sort_by @timestamp desc
```
chris: then click "Save" -> name it `acme | eu | acme-gen | 5xx` and tag `ops,oncall`
maria: prob better naming convention: `acme-eu-acme-gen-5xx` (no spaces) so alerts/links don't break.
jamal: perfect. where's the dashboard link for latency + error rate for that route?
maria: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/dashboards/acme-route-overview -> filter dropdown -> route = acme-gen-eu, region = eu
sre-oncall: fyi we saw noise yesterday around 429->500 cascades. if you want an alert tweak I suggest changing the alert to fire on "5xx rate > 2% over 5m" instead of absolute count. reduces noise for bursty traffic.
jamal: can you create the saved search and adjust the alert or should I?
sre-oncall: i can do it. i'll: 1) save the query as `acme-eu-acme-gen-5xx` 2) create/update metric alert `acme-gen-5xx-rate-eu` threshold 2% 3) add playbook link in alert text.
chris: for the metric it's easiest to create a logs-based metric: use aggregation `count(http.status_code >= 500)` / `count(total requests)` over 5m window.
maria: snippet for logs-based metric extraction (copy into Metric -> from Logs):
```
source: logs
query: org:acme AND route:acme-gen-eu AND region:eu
extract: status = http.status_code
metric: rate(status >= 500) / rate(count())
window: 5m
```
jamal: lovely. once saved can you ping #incidents if the alert is changed? want to link to the incident runbook.
sre-oncall: will do. tagging in alert -> add `#incidents` and `@oncall-sre` mentions.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-11-02 -> 2 instances in eu region updated.
jamal: hmmm could the deploy be related? last deploy ~10m before spike.
chris: maybe. correlate span traces: go to Traces -> filter service:acme-gen, time range 15m before spike, look for increased latency or error rates.
maria: FYI saved search path in Console UI: Observability -> Logs -> Saved searches (or direct: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/saved-searches).
jamal: thanks all. if anyone saves the query pls drop the saved-search id here so I can pin it to the incident.
sre-oncall: saved `acme-eu-acme-gen-5xx` -> id: s-98234 (created). updated alert `acme-gen-5xx-rate-eu` -> new threshold 2%/5m, added playbook and #incidents.
jamal: received, thx. i'll start triage with traces + dashboard. :thumbsup:
chris: if you need a quick loghunt helper here's a compact filter for the search bar to show request ids and stack traces: `org:acme AND route:acme-gen-eu AND region:eu AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599] | fields request_id, stack, message | sort_by @timestamp desc`
maria: pro-tip: add `| limit 200` at end when hitting UI to avoid paging.
jamal: saved the link to the dashboard and pinned the saved search id in the incident doc. thanks team.
sre-oncall: closing loop: will monitor for 30m and revert alert if it generates false positives. ping me if noisy.
jamal: will do."
